verdict.rationale: Tilled's first-party docs have a dedicated Webhooks section and a WebhooksAPI that delivers real-time notifications to your application about platform events. That is direct support for event subscriptions. The evidence does not show how endpoints are registered, which event types can be selected, or how deliveries are verified and retried, so full coverage is not established. missing for 10: documented endpoint registration/subscription flow, event-type catalog and filtering, signature verification and retry semantics, independent or hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Webhooks provide real-time notifications to your application about events occurring on platform.
